description: This Java source file defines the exception class 'PolicyNotAllowedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class extends a runtime exception and implements a ThingException, representing an error when a policy-containing Thing cannot be modified. It includes builder patterns, static factory methods, and related exception handling infrastructure.
